demo.title: monitor-chat.txt
demo.code:
You:    start Monitor on Elysium in Balanced mode with 100 HYPE
Bankr:  Balanced: Monitor tracks 20 strong Elysium wallets, 5% of the account per buy (about 5 HYPE),
        15% fee on profit above your high-water mark, taken at withdrawal.
        No backtest yet; meme coins can lose most of the money put in.
        Account: 0x9c1e...40b2 (your own smart account, checked on-chain)
        Sign 4 permissions (swap via the guarded contract only, withdraw to YOUR
        wallet only, fee address only, ~1 year) and deposit 100 HYPE on Elysium? [Yes]
You:    yes
Bankr:  Signed 4/4. Deposited 100 HYPE (tx 0x...). Monitor is live.

- later -
You:    how is my Monitor account doing?
Bankr:  Value 104.2 HYPE ($7,438) | put in 100 | result +4.2 HYPE
        3 open positions, 11 trades. Fee paid so far: 0.

You:    stop and withdraw everything
Bankr:  Stopped, 3 positions sold, 104.0 HYPE sent to your wallet on Elysium.

setup: In Bankr security settings, turn on arbitrary contract calls (needs MFA; a timer is fine) and keep permitted recipients off while signing
Hold HYPE on Elysium (chain 99901) in your Bankr wallet: bridge it from HyperEVM in chat, plus about 0.01 HYPE for gas
Say "start Monitor on Elysium in Balanced mode with 50 HYPE", then "how is my Monitor account doing?" or "stop and withdraw everything"
